title: More Ores Tools Effects
description: A Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mod that adds 15 new ores, each with full tool and armor sets and unique passive potion effects.
body:
⚒️ MoreOresToolsEffects

A Minecraft Forge mod that expands your world with 15 new ores, each with a complete set of tools, armor, and unique passive potion effects. Every ore has both a stone and deepslate variant, a craftable storage block, and a full progression path from entry-level gems to legendary Rainbow gear.

⚠️ Incompatible with OptiFine. Use Sodium or Iris instead.

⚙️ Supported Versions & Modloaders:
Forge 47.2.0+ : 1.20.1

📦 Current Version: 1.3.5
Mod ID: oreexpansion

💎 Ores Added:

All ores generate in the Overworld and come in both stone and deepslate variants. Each ore drops a gem or ingot used to craft a full tool set and armor set.

Citrine — Yellow gem. Mining level 2. Beginner-tier.
Opal — Iridescent gem. Mining level 2. Enchanting bonus.
Jade — Green gem. Mining level 2. Healing properties.
Aquamarine — Cyan gem. Mining level 2. Ocean-attuned.
Garnet — Deep red gem. Mining level 3. Combat-focused.
Ruby — Bright red gem. Mining level 3. Fire-resistant.
Silver — Silver metal. Mining level 3. Defensive metal.
Sapphire — Blue gem. Mining level 4. Swift and agile.
Cobalt — Dark blue gem. Mining level 4. Speed specialist.
Chromium — Metallic gray. Mining level 4. Industrial metal.
Bismuth — Iridescent pink-purple metal. Mining level 4. Lucky alloy.
Mythril — Purple mythical metal. Mining level 5. Legendary material.
Tungsten — Dark steel. Mining level 5. Heaviest metal.
Titanium — Light gray metal. Mining level 5. Elite warrior material.
Rainbow — Legendary ore. Mining level 6. Rarest material in the mod. Generates deep underground (Y -64 to +16). 8000 durability, 14.0 mining speed.
✨ Passive Potion Effects:

Wearing armor or holding tools grants permanent passive effects. No potions needed.

Citrine — Haste I — Holding any Citrine tool
Opal — Luck I — Any Opal armor piece
Jade — Regeneration I — Full Jade armor set
Aquamarine — Water Breathing + Dolphin's Grace — Any Aquamarine armor piece
Garnet — Strength I — Any Garnet armor piece
Ruby — Fire Resistance + Strength I — Any Ruby armor piece
Silver — Resistance I — Any Silver armor piece
Sapphire — Speed I + Jump Boost I — Any Sapphire armor piece
Cobalt — Speed II — Full Cobalt armor set
Chromium — Haste I + Resistance I — Any Chromium armor piece
Bismuth — Luck II + Regeneration I — Full Bismuth armor set
Mythril — Speed II + Jump Boost II — Full Mythril armor set
Tungsten — Resistance II + Strength I — Any Tungsten armor piece
Titanium — Strength II + Resistance I — Full Titanium armor set
Rainbow — Speed III + Strength III + Haste III + Resistance III + Regeneration III + Luck III — Any Rainbow armor piece

Opal — 4/6/7/4 = 21 total | Toughness: 0.0
Jade — 4/6/7/4 = 21 total | Toughness: 0.0
Aquamarine — 4/7/7/4 = 22 total | Toughness: 0.0
Garnet — 4/7/7/4 = 22 total | Toughness: 0.5
Ruby — 4/7/8/4 = 23 total | Toughness: 0.5
Silver — 5/7/8/4 = 24 total | Toughness: 1.0
Sapphire — 5/8/8/4 = 25 total | Toughness: 1.0
Cobalt — 5/8/8/4 = 25 total | Toughness: 1.0
Chromium — 5/8/8/5 = 26 total | Toughness: 1.5
Bismuth — 5/8/9/5 = 27 total | Toughness: 1.5
Mythril — 5/8/9/5 = 27 total | Toughness: 2.0
Tungsten — 5/8/10/5 = 28 total | Toughness: 2.0
Titanium — 5/8/10/5 = 28 total | Toughness: 2.5
Rainbow — 6/10/13/7 = 36 total | Toughness: 4.0 | KBR: 0.5
⚔️ Tool Stats (Mining Level | Durability | Speed | Enchantability):

Every ore crafts a full tool set: Sword, Axe, Pickaxe, Shovel, Hoe, and Battleaxe. All swords deal +5 damage bonus, axes +7, battleaxes +7.

Citrine — Lv.2 | 300 uses | 6.0 speed | 22 ench.
Opal — Lv.2 | 350 uses | 6.5 speed | 20 ench.
Jade — Lv.2 | 400 uses | 6.5 speed | 18 ench.
Aquamarine — Lv.2 | 450 uses | 7.0 speed | 17 ench.
Garnet — Lv.3 | 500 uses | 7.0 speed | 16 ench.
Ruby — Lv.3 | 700 uses | 7.5 speed | 14 ench.
Silver — Lv.3 | 800 uses | 8.0 speed | 20 ench.
Sapphire — Lv.4 | 900 uses | 8.0 speed | 22 ench.
Cobalt — Lv.4 | 1,000 uses | 8.0 speed | 14 ench.
Chromium — Lv.4 | 1,200 uses | 8.5 speed | 12 ench.
Bismuth — Lv.4 | 1,400 uses | 8.5 speed | 25 ench.
Mythril — Lv.5 | 1,600 uses | 9.0 speed | 18 ench.
Tungsten — Lv.5 | 1,800 uses | 9.0 speed | 10 ench.
Titanium — Lv.5 | 2,031 uses | 9.0 speed | 12 ench.
Rainbow — Lv.6 | 8,000 uses | 14.0 speed | 35 ench.
🌍 Worldgen:

All ores generate exclusively in the Overworld. Rainbow Ore generates between Y -64 and +16 using a diamond-style trapezoid height distribution, with 7 veins per chunk and vein sizes up to 8 blocks.

📋 Version History:

1.3.5 — Rainbow Ore rework, armor +2 across all materials, +2 weapon damage, cover art, display name update
1.3.4 — Passive effects for all 15 ores via LivingTickEvent
1.3.3 — Global loot modifier: Warden drops 1–3 Warden Shards
1.3.2 — JSON generation for all textures, models, lang, recipes, loot tables, and worldgen
1.3.1 — Creative tab with all mod items
1.3.0 — Initial release: 208 registered items across 15 ore materials
